output_list.reason:
The function buy() allows the contract to hold an unbounded amount of ETH. If the contract is called with a large amount of ETH, it will result in an overflow of the balanceOf[this] variable. This will result in:
            1. Loss of Funds: The attacker can buy tokens at a very low price, then sell them at a high price, effectively taking all the ETH from the contract.
            2. Smart Contract Failure: The attacker can prevent the contract from ever receiving ETH by continuously calling buy().
